## Typst live preview that always catches up, and Force Recompile

Builds on **0.1.34**. Small edits in Typst edit + preview mode (one character, whitespace, undo/redo, paste) now always reach the preview. A new **Force Recompile** button and command rebuild the preview from scratch.

### Small edits always update the preview
- The preview tracks which editor revision it has asked for and which it has shown. When an edit lands while a compile is running, a follow-up compile is queued as soon as that compile finishes, so the last keystroke is never dropped.
- The compile-answer listener no longer stops for good when the window is busy (for example while a menu or modal is open). Before this fix, that left the preview frozen until the tab was reopened.
- The live compiler thread now recovers from panics in import polling and IDE queries (jump to source and definition) as well as in compiles. A recovered panic is reported to the preview instead of silently killing the worker.
- Progressive painting keeps the page count stable while it fills in pages, so the scroll position no longer jumps back during an edit.
- Pinned previews keep the right pin after you close, reorder or split tabs. A pinned preview still ignores edits to other documents and updates for edits to its own.
- Replaced preview pages are released from GPUI's image cache and atlas, so memory no longer grows a few MiB with every keystroke.

### Force Recompile
- A **Recompile** button sits in the Typst preview header. While it runs, the button shows a spinner and reads **Recompiling…**.
- **Typst: Force Recompile** is available in the command palette.
- The shortcut is **Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B** (Windows / Linux) or **⌥⇧⌘B** (macOS). It doesn't conflict with VS Code's default keys.
- A forced recompile skips the debounce, the render budget and every cache (compiled sheets, the file and package cache, and comemo memoization). It rebuilds the pinned document when that one is shown beside another tab, and the active document otherwise.

### Verify
- `cargo test typst_live::`
- `cargo test force_recompile`
- `cargo test --locked`
- `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`
